fun [endOffsetMillis](end-offset-millis.html)(endOffsetMillis: [Long](https://kotlinlang.org/api/core/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-long/index.html)?): [VideoMetadata.Builder](index.html)

Sets [endOffset](../../../../google-adk-kotlin-core/com.google.adk.kt.types/-video-metadata/-builder/end-offset.html) in milliseconds, or clears it when `null`. The non-null overload remains for binary compatibility and so Java `int` literals still compile.
